featuredReviews.title: When you come to Accra, you must experience the Cape Coast and Kakum National Park  with Expedition Tours!
featuredReviews.text:
When you come to Accra, you must experience the Cape Coast and Kakum National Park with Expedition Tours! I had an amazing time with Emmanuel and Christopher.

They were wonderful, and I would absolutely do it again to learn even more about the rich history and beautiful culture Ghana has to offer.

Expedition Tours was incredibly accommodating and responded to my inquiries right away.

Thank you, Expedition Tours, for an unforgettable experience! I highly recommend you to anyone visiting Ghana.

featuredReviews.title: Must visit Cape Coast Castle!!!
featuredReviews.text:
Wow, what an impactful experience. I booked this because I wanted to go on the canopy tour, but the Cape Coast Castle will stay with me forever - reading and watching videos does not compare to being in the dungeons and walking the grounds.

Additionally, I met a new friend and learned all about Singapore during the long drive, which our guide was very efficient and safe with.

featuredReviews.title: Awesome Tour !!!
featuredReviews.text: This is definitely worth booking. Our tour guide, Kwame and our driver, Elvis were an amazing duo. We were warmly greeted and provided water on pick up. As we were en route, they pointed out significant sights and presented historical references. They even went above and beyond by offering to take group photos. The restaurant that we stopped at for lunch provided delicious meal and beverage choices. I liked that we placed our order at the restaurant early so that our food was served hot and promptly. I would definitely take this tour again.

featuredReviews.text: The trip was great! My favorite sites were the W. E. B. Du Bois Memorial Centre for Pan-African Culture, Kwame Nkrumah Memorial Park and The Black Star Square! Our guide was great! I highly recommend this Accra Guided City Tour Cultural and Historical Experience!

It was a very detailed tour. Our tour guide Emmanuel was very helpful, he helped with pictures, and also took us to a nice restaurant spot to eat afterwards, and the drive between all the spots for the tour was smooth.

Had a fantastic day. Emmanuel was knowledgeable, friendly and told us a lot about Ghana and living in Ghana as well as the sights we saw. We were the only 2 on the tour and therefore got to go at our own pace. Highly recommend.

This tour was a great way to get an overview of most of the primary sights of Accra. The guides were helpful, and the transport was comfortable and air conditioned. Pickup at our hotel was convenient and on time. Would recommend!

Emmanuel was a great guide. The roads under construction was massive but he was a great driver. Was quite a discovery journey and the highlight was the canopy walk at the kakum conservative! Overall a good ride!

featuredReviews.text: Emmanuel was a wonderful guide for a really difficult but highly informative tour. Glad the national park was a part of the tour to bring some levity. Thank you Emmanuel for a great tour
